column1: # TITLE: Signature of MicroRNAs with Impact on Angiogenesis in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
# SUMMARY: Angiogenesis is regarded as a hallmark in cancer development
column2: and anti-angiogenic treatment is presently used in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients. MicroRNAs (miRs) are small non-coding
column4: single stranded RNAs that regulate gene expression. As miRs are relatively stabile and measurable in both tissue and serum
column5: they are potential prognostic and predictive markers. In this study we aimed to identify significant altered miRs related to angiogenesis in NSCLC
